desc: s holds a nested list of integers such as "[1,[2,-3],[]]". First remove every space character. The rest must be exactly one list: list = "[" then either "]" or element, zero or more of ("," element), then "]"; element = integer or list; integer = an optional "-" followed by one or more decimal digits. Return the integers in left-to-right order, paired with the maximum nesting depth of lists (the outer list has depth 1). If the text is not valid, return the error "invalid at N", where N is the 0-based position (in the text with spaces removed) of the first character that cannot continue a valid input, or the length of that text if it ends too early.

decls.ts: type Result<T> = { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: string };
